title: Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5
content:
## Overview

On June 9, 2026, Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 — its most capable models to date and the first in a new "Fable" performance tier positioned above Opus. Three days later, a US government export-control directive suspended access to both models worldwide. As of late June 2026, the situation remains in flux.

---

## Claude Fable 5

`claude-fable-5` is the first model in Anthropic's new Fable tier — a step above Opus in capability. It is state-of-the-art across nearly all tested benchmarks, with particular strength in software engineering, scientific reasoning, vision, and long-horizon knowledge work.

**Key specifications:**

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Model ID | `claude-fable-5` |
| Context window | 1,000,000 tokens |
| Max output tokens | 128,000 |
| Input pricing | $10 / 1M tokens |
| Output pricing | $50 / 1M tokens |
| Batch input | $5 / 1M tokens |
| Batch output | $25 / 1M tokens |
| Cache hits | $1 / 1M tokens (90% off standard input) |

The full 1M-token context window is available at standard per-token rates — no long-context surcharge. Fable 5 ships with **always-on adaptive thinking**: extended reasoning is integrated by default rather than as a separate mode toggle.

---

## Benchmark Performance

Fable 5 set new records across multiple domains at launch:

- **SWE-Bench Pro (software engineering):** 80.3% — the next-best model was 11 points behind
- **Complex analytics (Anthropic internal benchmark):** First model to break 90%, a 10-point jump over Opus 4.8
- **Hebbia Finance Benchmark (senior-level knowledge work):** Highest score of any model; substantial gains in document-based reasoning, chart and table interpretation, and multi-step problem solving
- **Vision:** New state-of-the-art; can extract precise numerical data from detailed scientific figures and reconstruct web application source code from screenshots

In a real-world stress test, Fable 5 completed a codebase-wide migration across a 50-million-line Ruby codebase in a single day — work Anthropic estimated would take a full engineering team more than two months.

---

## Claude Mythos 5

Claude Mythos 5 is the underlying model on which Fable 5 is built. It has identical capabilities but ships without Fable 5's safety classifiers. Access is limited to a small set of vetted partners via **Project Glasswing** and is not available through the standard API.

Fable 5 implements Mythos's capabilities with layered safety filters. When those safeguards trigger — tuned conservatively, firing in fewer than 5% of sessions on average — queries are routed to Claude Opus 4.8 instead. On sensitive topics, users see an Opus 4.8 response rather than a refusal.

---

## US Government Export-Control Suspension

**Timeline:**

- **June 9, 2026** — Fable 5 and Mythos 5 released to all API customers
- **June 12, 2026** — US Commerce Department Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), under Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, issued a directive requiring Anthropic to immediately suspend access to both models for all foreign nationals worldwide
- **Late June 2026** — Trump administration authorized access for some US companies and government agencies; status of international access remains unresolved

**Why the suspension:** US officials told Anthropic a technique had been discovered to bypass Fable 5's safety classifiers in a specific scenario, potentially exposing Mythos's advanced cybersecurity capabilities. Anthropic contested the characterization, arguing the jailbreak was narrow (one specific interaction pattern, not a universal bypass) and that comparable techniques could elicit similar behavior from other publicly available models including OpenAI's GPT-5.5, which are not subject to the same controls.

**Broader context:** In February 2026, after months of failed contract renegotiations, President Trump directed all federal agencies to stop using Anthropic's products. The Pentagon had demanded Anthropic waive contractual restrictions on using Claude for mass domestic surveillance and for fully autonomous weapons systems without human oversight over targeting and firing decisions. Anthropic refused.

The June suspension is considered an unprecedented use of export controls applied to an AI model, and has prompted significant legal and policy debate about the scope of BIS authority over software.

---

## Developer Access Status

As of late June 2026, Claude Fable 5 is unavailable via the standard Anthropic API to most developers. Access to Claude Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, and Haiku 4.5 is unaffected. Monitor the Anthropic models overview page for updates on Fable 5 availability.
